title: The Kept Man of the Princess Knight Anime Reveals New Trailer, Additional Cast, January 3 Premiere
content: The Kept Man of the Princess Knight anime revealed a new trailer, additional cast and a January 3, 2027 premiere date. Additionally, sajou no hana sings the ending theme song “Gika.” The additional cast consists of: • Yuya Hirose as Ralph • Manaka Iwami as Noel • Shion Wakayama as Beatrice • Saori Onishi as Cecilia…
author: Anime Corner

title: Kindergarten WARS Unveils New Visual and Trailer, Opening Theme Song Artist Ado
content: Kindergarten WARS anime has unveiled the main visual and a new trailer on Wednesday. The latest trailer features the opening theme song “Bibayatarametta” by Ado. The series debuts in April 2027. Studio Sunrise and Felix Film are animating the series with Shinsuke Gomi as director.
author: Anime Corner

title: Demon Slayer Studio’s New Movie Confirms Return With New Sequel
content: The newest movie from the studio behind the Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba anime franchise has announced it’s now working on a new sequel to its latest release, Witch on the Holy Night. Studio Ufotable has been busy the last few years with all sorts of new projects now in various stages of development.
author: ComicBook

title: New Shonen Jump Anime Confirms 2027 Release With First Look Trailer – Watch
content: Another major series from Shueisha’s Shonen Jump library is making its official anime debut next year, and has dropped the first look at what to expect with its first full trailer. With 2027 fast approaching, it’s time to look ahead to all of the new Shonen Jump franchise releases we’ll see in the new year .

title: Now That We Draw Anime Reveals New Trailer, Main Visual, Additional Cast, Ending Theme Song Artist
content: Now That We Draw anime revealed a new trailer and a main visual. Additionally, Hina Youmiya joins the cast and Inner Journey sings “Serifu wa Iranai” for the ending theme song. The series is set to premiere on January 8, 2027, and it stars Sayumi Suzushiro stars as Niina Miyamoto and Ayumu Murase as Yuuki Uehara.
author: Anime Corner

title: Ted: The Animated Series Reveals Big Returns With New Sneak Peek – Watch Now
content: Ted is coming back with a brand new animated series hitting Peacock later this December, and a new sneak peek clip from Ted: The Animated Series is highlighting some big returns from the massively popular TV series.
author: ComicBook

title: At 25:00, in Akasaka Gets Anime
content: At 25:00, in Akasaka boys’ love manga by Hiroko Natsuno is getting an anime adaptation. A teaser visual and trailer have also been unveiled and the main cast will reprise their roles from the drama CDs, with Soma Saito voicing Yuki Shirasaki and Takuya Sato voicing Asami Hayama. The anime premieres in 2027.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Kakunaru Ue wa' Unveils Additional Cast, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content: The official website of the Kakunaru Ue wa ( Now That We Draw ) television anime unveiled additional cast, a key visual (pictured), the theme songs, and second promotional video on Wednesday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'At 25:00, in Akasaka' Boys-Love Manga Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: Pony Canyon announced on Wednesday the television anime adaptation of Hiroko Natsuno 's At 25:00, in Akasaka ( 25-Ji, Akasaka de ) boys-love manga, and presented the anime's teaser trailer, teaser visual, and main cast members. The anime will premiere in 2027 on the TBS channel.
author: ANN
